notes: Only independent reviews found are of the first-gen Boca Rev (EBReport and EBR); used EBReport for specs that match the Rev 2 page (class, 14 mph, 500W, 500Wh, 500 lb payload, height, folding frame). Range changed (first-gen claim 49 mi vs Rev 2 75 mi) so the review's range isn't used. EBR's first-gen review lists 28 MPH top speed, contradicting EBReport and the maker's 14 mph, so EBR was not used. Rev 2 maker page doesn't list a weight; 85 lb is the first-gen tested weight. Fold: maker gives folded dimensions (38.5" vs 63.5" long), EBReport confirms the first-gen frame folds. Recheck: read the V5 Boca Rev 2 manual PDF linked from the product page (spec table has no weight), one web search, Retrospec's help-center weight table ('Boca Rev' 91 lbs, generation not given).
